behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: An unseen concurrent addition survives an observed removal and replicas converge.
Tombstone arriving before addition prevents resurrection.
docDelivery: Addition tags identify values and remove only observes local tags.
Union merge, retained tombstones, atomic conflict rejection and detached sorted snapshots.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: String values/tags arbitrary ASCII including empty/prototype-like names; tag identifies exactly one value globally, conflicts rejected. Snapshot {adds:[[value,tag]],removed:[tag]} finite dense arrays, duplicates permitted. Tombstones may arrive before associated adds.
independence: Implement tagged add/remove operations and replica merge retaining concurrent additions.
